messages:
deploy-bot: publish failed for gcr://us-central1/redwood-prod/models-api:stable - signed manifest expired (attestation: expired_signature)

sam: looks like the attestation signature TTL expired during the build window. saw failures in the release job.

jordan: confirmed. CI uploaded image, attestation timestamp is 2024-04-10T02:14Z, KMS key rotated 2024-04-11 -> signature no longer verifiable by our provenance guard.

maya: ugh. does this block the release or can we retag/re-sign?

sam: two options: 1) rollback the deploy entirely, 2) re-sign + retag and push a new manifest (preferred if we can do it quickly).

lee: if we re-sign we need to ensure replay protection and that the deploybot will accept the new attestation. deploybot currently rejects expired timestamps.

jordan: we can create a new signed manifest using the original image sha256; no rebuild. quick steps:
```
# get original digest from GCR
gcloud artifacts docker images list-tags us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/redwood-prod/models-api --filter="tags:stable" --format="get(digest)"
# add new tag pointing at same digest
gcloud artifacts docker images add-tag us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/redwood-prod/models-api@sha256:abcd1234 us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/redwood-prod/models-api:20240412-expfix
# sign the manifest with the active KMS key
cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/release/cryptoKeys/prov-key us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/redwood-prod/models-api:20240412-expfix
```

sam: sounds good. estimate ~15-20m to retag + sign + push, then run a canary deploy.

maya: do we need a change window? this is a hotfix to avoid rollback. i'd rather do it now and monitor.

lee: ops checklist: update release notes with the temporary tag, notify oncall, and patch the deploybot rule to accept the new attestation epoch for this one-off. i'll handle deploybot patch if we agree.

sam: agreed. plan: 1) retag+cosign sign 2) push 3) run 10% canary on dedicated pool 4) monitor 5) promote. will open a short PR in release-control to add the tag and note.

jordan: i'll run the retag/sign steps and post digests here. tagging now.

jordan: done. new tag us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/redwood-prod/models-api:20240412-expfix -> sha256:abcd1234. signed with prov-key.

deploy-bot: noticed new signed artifact: models-api:20240412-expfix. provenance check: OK.

sam: kicking off canary deploy to dedicated-pool-canary-2 (10%). will watch latency & error rate dashboards.

maya: i'm on metrics. exposing token-level traces and per-model latency.

lee: patched deploybot rule to accept this attestation epoch for this release id. PR: https://git.redwood/release-control/pulls/431

jordan: canary looks good at 10% after 12 minutes. no regressions in 95th latency.

sam: promote to 50% for 10m, then full if stable. notifying #all-hands and release channels.

maya: FYI, we'll add a small postmortem note for build/release runbook: rotate KMS key and signature TTL alignment.

sam: closing loop: created release notes entry: "hotfix: re-signed manifest for models-api due to attestation TTL mismatch; retagged as 20240412-expfix". tagging release as hotfix.

lee: follow-ups: add CI check to verify KMS key rotation window vs signature TTL; and create alert if attestation verification fails during publish.

sam: thanks everyone. moving thread to archive after final promotion. :thumbsup:
